cache_mode: F_NOCACHE + durable cache disabled + wait for all VFS reads/prefetches idle + clear VFS hot/durable/sequential state before each point; hot chunks reused within a sample
workload: open read-only FD for each point, pread 1 MiB, SHA256, close; head16k reads only 16 KiB at the same offsets
v061_instrumentation: Go overlay adds cache-clear endpoint delegating to existing ClearReadCacheForMount and wait begin/end logs; reader/driver policy otherwise unchanged
diagnostic_override: test binary only: Quark Interactive.Sequential.Prefetch disabled; all other policy fields unchanged; not applied to project defaults
limits: Measured complete reads, not player decode/render first frame or CDN TTFB
Cold clearing also resets session classification; each point begins as initial, then contiguous FUSE reads become sequential
Raw driver nonce, URL metadata and CDN caches are not disabled
First two formal rounds partly overlapped local CI; provider bandwidth drift is visible; no cross-version speedup claim
Progress counts plaintext returned by wrapped driver; excludes nonce/header/warmup/private HTTP traffic, so not complete network amplification
Calibration runs without idle drain excluded; old lookaheads can repopulate cache after a clear
First formal candidate round predates first_chunk_us instrumentation; later rounds include it

v061_partial_round.reason: bounded diagnosis after consecutive 27-32 second reads; completed samples retained, partial round excluded from complete-round percentiles

commands: qrypt debug raw /v1/ops --config <private-config> # wait for no VFS reads or prefetches
